title: Christ's Sacrifice Once for All, Full Assurance of Faith

questions.question: For since the law has but a shadow of the good things to come instead of the true form of these realities, it can never, by the same____ that are continually offered every year, make perfect those who draw near.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:1 (ESV): "For since the law has but a shadow of the good things to come instead of the true form of these realities, it can never, by the same sacrifices that are continually offered every year, make perfect those who draw near."

questions.question: But in these sacrifices there is a reminder of ____ every year.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:3 (ESV): "But in these sacrifices there is a reminder of sins every year."

questions.question: For it is impossible for the blood of ____ and ____ to take away sins.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:4 (ESV): "For it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins."

questions.question: Consequently, when Christ came into the world, he said, "Sacrifices and offerings you have not desired, but a ____ have you prepared for me;"
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:5 (ESV): "Consequently, when Christ came into the world, he said, 'Sacrifices and offerings you have not desired, but a body have you prepared for me;'"

questions.question: And by that will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ ____ for all.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:10 (ESV): "And by that will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all."

questions.question: But when Christ had offered for all time a single sacrifice for sins, he sat down at the ____ hand of God,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:12 (ESV): "But when Christ had offered for all time a single sacrifice for sins, he sat down at the right hand of God,"

questions.question: waiting from that time until his enemies should be made a ____ for his feet.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:13 (ESV): "waiting from that time until his enemies should be made a footstool for his feet."

questions.question: For by a single ____ he has perfected for all time those who are being sanctified.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:14 (ESV): "For by a single offering he has perfected for all time those who are being sanctified."

questions.question: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the holy places by the ____ of Jesus,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:19 (ESV): "Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the holy places by the blood of Jesus,"

questions.question: let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, with our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:22 (ESV): "let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, with our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water."

questions.question: Let us hold fast the confession of our ____ without wavering, for he who promised is faithful.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:23 (ESV): "Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for he who promised is faithful."

questions.question: And let us consider how to stir up one another to love and good ____,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:24 (ESV): "And let us consider how to stir up one another to love and good works,"

questions.question: not neglecting to ____ together, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another, and all the more as you see the Day drawing near.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:25 (ESV): "not neglecting to meet together, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another, and all the more as you see the Day drawing near."

questions.question: For if we go on sinning deliberately after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a ____ for sins,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:26 (ESV): "For if we go on sinning deliberately after receiving the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,"

questions.question: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the ____ God.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:31 (ESV): "It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God."

key_verse_text: And let us consider how to stir up one another to love and good works, not neglecting to meet together, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another, and all the more as you see the Day drawing near.
